description: Agent CLI version claims the Windows install lane (scripts/test-enterprise-windows-install.ps1) stages in the runner account's profile, at AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\<package>\package.json, so standalone enrollment admits a Claude Code and a Codex row. Each version is a pinned release client (scripts/windows-native-ci.ps1) with a known Windows hook contract; internal/enterprisehooks pins that discovery and admission accept exactly these.
